summary: ERROR TO THE CIRCUIT COURT OF THE UNITED STATES FOR THE EASTERN DISTRICT OF LOUISIANA.
attorneys: Mr. Attorney General and Mr. Solicitor General Phillips for the plaintiff in error., Mr. W. W. Howe and Mr. J. H. Kennard for the defendants in error.

opinions.author: Blatchford
opinions.text:
Mr. Justice Blatchford

delivered the opinion of the court.

The questions presented in this case are the same as those in the other suit between the same parties, decided herewith, and for the reasons assigned in the opinion in that ease the judgment" in this case is Affirmed.
